name: Kratos - Pantheon (fixed)
creator: magnaplayer
description:
Not my best mod, but it still turned out looking pretty cool.

It includes a few custom animations designed to fit the Blades of Chaos. Some of them might look a bit janky, but they help match the weapon’s style and feel more natural in motion.

Overall, it’s a fun result and I’m happy with how it came together.
